title: nephrodium unitum
intro: Nephrodium unitum, commonly known as the Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Athyriaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lady Fern include its use as a demulcent, soothing irritated mucous membranes, and its ability to act as a diuretic, promoting urine production to remove excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of Nephrodium unitum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
